title: Hjalmar Schacht advises Sukarno on a revolutionary fund
summary: Peter Levenda tells of Hjalmar Schacht advises Sukarno on a revolutionary fund, about post-war, 1950s-1960s at Indonesia (disaster zone), and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: He had met Sucarno. He had been denosified, shocked, and had wound up in Indonesia visiting Sukarno saying you have to build an Islamic crescent to defend against Chinese communism, right?
